verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms Ashby serves an llms.txt at developers.ashbyhq.com (HTTP 200) that tells agents to append .md to any docs page for a markdown version, and a second probe confirms .md pages resolve and point back to the documentation index. That gives agents a direct, working entry point into the docs. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths return 404), and no evidence of an llms-full.txt or first-party documentation describing the agent-docs offering.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Append .md to any documentation page URL to get its markdown version.
Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://developers.ashbyhq.com/l
